note: Igris downloadable assets, fetched at runtime from EXPO_PUBLIC_ASSET_MANIFEST_URL so a new model never needs an app rebuild. v2 replaced the two loose Piper files with the sherpa-onnx bundle: sherpa needs tokens.txt and espeak-ng-data/ for phonemisation, which Piper's own .onnx.json does not provide. v3 adds the ears. Repoint url at this repo's GitHub Release once assets-v1 is cut (PLAN.md decision #9).

assets.title: Igris voice
assets.detail: Piper en_GB-alan-medium, packaged for sherpa-onnx with its phoneme data. The same voice the Mac speaks with.

assets.title: Igris ears
assets.detail: Streaming Zipformer transducer, English. Recognises while you speak and detects when you stop, so no separate VAD is needed.
